action.command:
echo "=== DMS healthz ==="; curl -s --max-time 8 http://localhost:18001/healthz; echo
echo "=== DMS openapi (first paths) ==="; curl -s --max-time 8 http://localhost:18001/openapi.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(Object.keys(j.paths).slice(0,15).join("\n"))}catch(e){console.log("ERR",s.slice(0,200))}})'

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "echo \"=== DMS healthz ===\"; curl -s --max-time 8 http://localhost:18001/healthz; echo\necho \"=== DMS openapi (first paths) ===\"; curl -s --max-time 8 http://localhost:18001/openapi.json | node -e 'let s=\"\";process.stdin.on(\"data\",d=>s+=d).on(\"end\",()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log(Object.keys(j.paths).slice(0,15).join(\"\\n\"))}catch(e){console.log(\"ERR\",s.slice(0,200))}})'", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check DMS health and API"}
